# Vivarch Hospital

> Vivarch Hospital is a multi-speciality hospital operated by Vivarch Healthcare Private Limited (MCA registered 24 January 2025), located in Borivali, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It offers Oncology & Hematology, Neurology, Epilepsy Care, Cardiology, Internal Medicine, General & Laparoscopic Surgery, Emergency Care, ICU, Diagnostics, Pharmacy, Pathology, and Radiology & Imaging (USG, Sonography, Digital X-Ray), with 24x7 emergency services.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Vivarch Healthcare Private Limited
- Brand name: Vivarch Hospital
- Address: Shiv Parbat Building, SV Rd, Parbat Nagar, Borivali, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400068, India
- Emergency phone: +91 93248 48801 (available 24 hours a day, every day)
- Email: vivarchhealthcare@gmail.com
- Website: https://vivarchhospital.com

## Leadership

- Dr. Vijay Vilasrao Sharnangat — Medical Director & Lead Oncologist. MBBS, MD Internal Medicine, DM Medical Oncology. ~20 years experience. Specializes in chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, hormone therapy, bone marrow transplant and cancer care. Affiliated with HCG Cancer Centre Borivali and Thunga Hospital. Profile: https://vivarchhospital.com/doctors/dr-vijay-vilasrao-sharnangat
- Dr. Rahil Rauf Ansari — Director of Neurological Services. MBBS, MD, DNB Neurology, DM Neurology, Fellowship in Epilepsy Surgery. 10+ years experience. Specializes in stroke, epilepsy, brain disorders and neuro critical care. Profile: https://vivarchhospital.com/doctors/dr-rahil-rauf-ansari
- Dr. Chandrashekhar Ramdavar Yadav — Director of Cardiology. MBBS, MD Medicine, DM Cardiology. 14+ years experience. Specializes in angiography, angioplasty, heart failure, hypertension and cardiac emergencies. Profile: https://vivarchhospital.com/doctors/dr-chandrashekhar-ramdavar-yadav
